description: This file defines the 'Color' struct in the MigraDoc.DocumentObjectModel namespace, representing ARGB and CMYK color values with parsing, conversion, and utility methods.

classes.name: Color
classes.description: Struct representing a color in ARGB and CMYK formats, with methods for creation, comparison, parsing, and representation.

methods.name: Color
methods.description: Constructors for various color formats (ARGB, RGB, ARGB with alpha, CMYK).

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a string to create a Color object, supporting hex formats, color names, and integers.

methods.name: FromRgb
methods.description: Creates a Color from red, green, blue components.

methods.name: FromArgb
methods.description: Creates a Color from alpha, red, green, blue components.

methods.name: FromCmyk
methods.description: Creates a Color from CMYK components.

methods.name: GetMixedTransparencyColor
methods.description: Returns a color mixed with transparency, adjusting RGB components accordingly.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the color in hex or named format.
